properties.title: Oskari Made Easy
properties.description:
Oskari (www.oskari.org & www.github.com/oskariorg) is an open source map application platform. This workshop will demonstrate how easy setting up web based services with an integrated map component can be. Participants will build a website with local tourist attractions and a map component from Oskari.

Oskari (www.oskari.org and www.github.com/oskariorg) is an open source map application platform with a growing community. This workshop will demonstrate how easy setting up web based services with an integrated map component can be. Participants of this workshop will learn hands-on how to utilize Oskari embedded maps with the RPC API by building a website with local tourist attractions and a map component from Oskari. Basic understanding about HTML/JavaScript is good to have but not mandatory to complete the workshop.
